name: Neverwinter
subtitle: The Jewel of the North
desc: City of Skilled Hands. Rebuilt along the warm, ice-free waters of the Neverwinter River under Lord Dagult Neverember.

wards.name: Protector's Enclave
wards.desc: Heart of governance, the Hall of Justice, bustling markets, and grand guild academies.

wards.name: Blacklake District
wards.desc: Walled noble estates, manicured gardens, high-end jewelers, and old aristocratic bloodlines.

wards.name: River District
wards.desc: Master clockmakers, glassblowers, bridges, and busy artisan workshops lining the warm river.

wards.name: Neverwinter Docks
wards.desc: Deepwater piers, Mintarn mercenary barracks, shipwrights, and weathered sea-traders.

wards.name: Beggar's Nest & Chasm Rim
wards.desc: Scarred ruins near the sealed Chasm, salvaged dungeon gear, and desperate street stalls.

wards.name: Skull Crag & Smuggler Caves
wards.desc: Hidden sea-caves beneath the cliffs where pirates and Zhentarim agents trade contraband.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Danneth Waylen - Veteran dwarf armorer with a braided silver beard
shops.Vibe & Decor: Polished half-plate stands beneath banners of Tyr; the ring of dwarven hammers echoes from the rear forge.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Serissa Vance - Sharp-eyed human swordsmith with heat-scarred forearms
shops.Vibe & Decor: Water-powered grindstones spin beside racks of river-quenched steel longswords, rapiers, and crossbows.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Magister Elindra Moonflower - Sun elf illusionist in star-embroidered robes
shops.Vibe & Decor: Floating driftglobes illuminate cedar shelves packed with spell scrolls, component pouches, and wands.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Barnaby Copperkettle - Cheerful rock gnome herbalist wearing magnifying goggles
shops.Vibe & Decor: Warm glass alembics bubble with crimson healing draughts, antitoxins, and Neverwinter botanical tinctures.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Garrick "Two-Mules" Thorne - Grizzled caravan master chewing pipeweed
shops.Vibe & Decor: Coils of hemp rope, waxed canvas tents, lanterns, rations, and iron pitons stacked to the rafters.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Lady Vespera Marcello - Poised Tethyrian gemologist with a crystal loupe
shops.Vibe & Decor: Velvet display cases guarded by arcane wards showcase cut sapphires, platinum filigree rings, and noble regalia.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Tock Brassfinger - Lantanese tinker with brass prosthetics
shops.Vibe & Decor: Ticking wall clocks, precision tumblers, thieves' tools, spyglasses, and delicate brass mechanisms.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Grimjaw - Half-orc scavenger sorting dented shields and dungeon pulls
shops.Vibe & Decor: Tarpaulins stretched over timber beams; barrels of notched axes, scavenged daggers, and cheap iron.

shops.Proprietor / Staff: Nyx "The Tide" - Tiefling smuggler draped in sea-wolf furs
shops.Vibe & Decor: Lantern-lit sea cave smelling of brine and drow poison; crates of untaxed luxuries and illicit blades.

eateries.Proprietor / Staff: Ophala Cheldarstorn - Mysterious, gracious hostess with masked servers
eateries.Vibe & Decor: Floating earthmote tethered by massive iron chains; silk divans, harp music, and exquisite vintages.

eateries.Proprietor / Staff: Madam Rosene - No-nonsense retired sea captain
eateries.Vibe & Decor: Built from the ribs of wrecked galleons; roaring hearth, roast river-trout, and frothy amber ale.
An entire caravel wedged permanently into the pier; hammocks, spiced rum, and salt-pork stew.

eateries.Proprietor / Staff: Brakka - Stout shield dwarf with an iron ladle
eateries.Vibe & Decor: Cracked wizard tower converted into a gritty taproom; cheap bitter stout and hot mutton pies.
